voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Bermuda, January nineteen forty-nine. Less than a year after the Star Tiger vanished, the same airline sent the same kind of airliner, the Star Ariel, to Jamaica.
This time the weather was fine. The captain reported good visibility.
About an hour out, he sent a routine message. He was changing radio frequency. Nothing more was heard.
Warships and aircraft searched for days. They found no wreckage at all.
The inquiry could not find a cause. One later theory is a fire from the cabin heater. The wreck has never been found.
